items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: After I got my first personal manager, I only had one personal manager, and that was Moe Gale. And, he treated me like his son.

ctx.x: What kind of, from the business end, what kind of experiences have you had with managers, and agents, and other people that are business men as opposed to being musicians because many musicians have had, you know, negative dealins as a result of the different approaches taken by artists and business people? Have you had any of those kinds of unfortunate circumstances?
No. I wasn't in too much trouble that way. After I got my first personal manager, I only had one personal manager, and that was Moe Gale. And, he treated me like his son.
I had an accountant that came in. And, he still, that's in the 40's, and he's still taking care of my books.
